Title: 496551-2026: Italy – Combined services provided by engineers – PFTE NEW TEACHING CAMPUS AND OFFICES AT THE FORMER VILLAGGIO MEDITERRANEO AREA
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a university/campus and office complex – university and campus projects are generally of interest for sbp. Project in Italy and without specific structural engineering details, therefore not a full score.
titel: New teaching campus and offices in the Ex Villaggio Mediterraneo area
kurzbeschreibung: In Chieti (Abruzzo), a new teaching campus with office space is being planned on the site of the former Villaggio Mediterraneo. The contract covers architectural and engineering services for the preparation of the technical and economic feasibility study (PFTE), including safety coordination in the design phase.
wettbewerb_art: Procurement procedure for architectural and engineering services (PFTE, quality-based competition)
gewinner: RTI Mario Cucinella Architects Surl – iDEAS – Tekser – LAP architettura s.r.l. s.t.p. – PARCNOUVEAU STP SRL – GAE Engineering – ambiente s.p.a. – CFA SRL General Contractor
gewinner_rolle: Design consortium for architectural and engineering services (PFTE, safety coordination)
gewinner_kontakt:
Contract value for planning (excluding VAT): 1955698.33 EUR
Lead of RTI: Mario Cucinella Architects Surl, Bologna, Italy, e-mail: mcarchitects@legalmail.it, tel.: +39 051 6313381
projektbeteiligte:
- Client: AreaCom - Agenzia regionale dell'Abruzzo per la Committenza, L'Aquila, Italy, e-mail: direzione@pec.areacom.eu, tel.: +39 0861 77101
- Winner / Lead of RTI: Mario Cucinella Architects Surl (architecture), Bologna, Italy, e-mail: mcarchitects@legalmail.it, tel.: +39 051 6313381
- Co-designer: LAP architettura s.r.l. s.t.p., Pescara, Italy, e-mail: laparchitettura@namirialpec.it, tel.: +39 340 2311606
- Co-designer: ambiente s.p.a., Carrara, Italy, e-mail: gareambiente@messaggipec.it, tel.: +39 0585 855624
- Co-designer: GAE Engineering, Torino, Italy, e-mail: segreteria@pec.gaeengineering.com, tel.: +39 011 0566426
- Co-designer: Tekser, Milano, Italy, e-mail: info@pec.tekser.it, tel.: +39 02 55230766
- Co-designer: iDEAS, Napoli, Italy, e-mail: admin@pec.ideas-ea.com, tel.: +39 081 3619405
- Co-designer: CFA SRL General Contractor, Milano, Italy, e-mail: cfasrl@pec.cheapnet.it, tel.: +39 348 3941327
- Co-designer: PARCNOUVEAU STP SRL, Milano, Italy, e-mail: parcnouveau@ultracert.it, tel.: +39 02 83548848
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- University/teaching campus and office buildings, fundamentally within sbp’s scope, but without identifiable long-span or iconic structures
- Pure planning contract (PFTE) in Italy, structural design presumably an integral part of the RTI and already awarded
- No bridge or sports facility, no large stadium, therefore only medium relevance for sbp core references
- Collaboration with an internationally renowned architectural office (Mario Cucinella) is in principle interesting, but the project is regional and more conventional building construction
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Project location Italy, no explicit tender for checking engineer services identifiable
- PFTE phase; subsequent regulatory checks will follow the Italian system, in which sbp as a German checking engineer plays little role
- No indication of exceptionally complex or long-span structures that would suggest an international second opinion
baukosten_erklaerung: Estimate: fee for PFTE and safety coordination approx. 1.96 million EUR net; with typical fee rates for early service phases in the range of 2–4 % of construction costs, this roughly results in a construction cost range of approx. 50–100 million EUR; a mid-range value of 65 million EUR is assumed.
naechste_schritte: No active acquisition for this project necessary. Record the project and participating offices (in particular Mario Cucinella Architects, GAE Engineering, Tekser) in the internal database as potential partners for future Italian projects, and adopt the contact details from the notice.
notes: Scope of services: service for the preparation of the Progetto di Fattibilità Tecnica ed Economica (PFTE) and safety coordination in the design phase for the new construction of a teaching campus and offices on the Ex Villaggio Mediterraneo site in Chieti. Award based on the economically most advantageous tender with a weighting of 80 % technical / 20 % price. Framework agreement with a maximum value of 3.26 million EUR; awarded offer for lot 1: 1.96 million EUR. 31 tenders received, 22 from SMEs, 19 excluded as inadmissible. Contract concluded on 16.07.2026. Structural design is very likely part of the commissioned engineering services within the RTI; no separate tender for structural design or checking engineer identifiable.
